facts.statement: Euro Truck Simulator 2 is a truck simulator game developed and published by SCS Software for Microsoft Windows, Linux, and macOS and was initially released as open development on 18 October 2012.[1] The game is a direct sequel to the 2008 game Euro Truck Simulator and it is the fourth video game in the Truck Simulator series.

facts.statement:
Development
Initially released for Windows and available for purchase and download via SCS's own website, the game was added to Steam in January 2013.[34] Expanding beyond the Windows version, SCS announced in March 2013 that they were developing a Mac version of the game.[35][36] One month later, they released a Linux beta version of the game to the public through Steam.[37] On 27 February, they stated "the Mac OS port of ETS 2 is taking longer than anybody would like, but trust us, we are still working hard on it."[38]
